description: Numeric conformance gate for the mom6_cgrid PPM flux/divergence rule quartet: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 test of problems/mom6_cgrid_flux_ppm.esm (model Mom6CgridFluxPpm, test flux_law_numeric) at the tiny grid N_I = N_J = 7, N_K = 1 through the Julia simulation pathway. The 14 instant assertions (time span 0 to 0) pin the rule-lowered zonal/meridional PPM layer fluxes, the C-grid face-flux divergences, and the explicit zero-flux east/north wall regions against the MOM6 laws evaluated by the independent Python transcription of the EqESM dump extractor (validated against the instrumented Fortran at rel 1e-12), at rel 1e-11. Unlike the AST fixture (tests/conformance/ast/mom6_cgrid_continuity, which pins the byte-identical post-lowering expansion by sha256), this case evaluates the lowered operators NUMERICALLY, so a rule change that keeps the expansion bytes intact but perturbs the arithmetic is caught here. The grid metaparameters arrive through the manifest's bindings entry, honored by the Julia runner via load_path(...; metaparameters=bindings) (the other bindings' simulation runners do not read it and are excluded below).

scope_excluded.python: python simulation runner does not read the manifest bindings entry yet (no metaparameter rebinding for simulation cases); add parity when it does
scope_excluded.rust: rust simulation runner does not read the manifest bindings entry yet (no metaparameter rebinding for simulation cases); add parity when it does
scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
